description:
Spacious Two Bedroom Semi-Detached Home with Generous Plot, Extensive Parking and Versatile Outbuildings.

Key Features

Two Double Bedrooms
Generous Plot with Potential
Extensive Off-Road Parking
Conservatory
Workshop & Separate Home Office
Multiple Reception Areas
Popular Dogsthorpe Location
Close to Local Amenities & Transport Links

Edward Stuart Estate Agents are pleased to offer for sale this well-proportioned two bedroom semi-detached home, occupying a generous plot in the popular residential area of Dogsthorpe. Offering excellent outdoor space, multiple reception areas and a range of useful outbuildings, this property presents an exciting opportunity for a variety of buyers.

The accommodation is arranged around a practical and flexible layout. A bright bay-fronted sitting room provides a welcoming living space, while a separate reception room offers further versatility and could be used as a dining room, family room or home office. The kitchen sits to the rear of the property and provides ample storage and workspace, with direct access to both the conservatory and the rear garden.

The conservatory adds an additional reception area and enjoys views over the garden, creating a pleasant space to relax throughout the year.

Upstairs, the property offers two comfortable double bedrooms together with a family bathroom fitted with a three-piece suite.

Outside is where this home truly stands apart. The substantial frontage provides extensive off-road parking for multiple vehicles, while the generous rear garden offers excellent outdoor space with scope for further landscaping or future extension potential, subject to the necessary planning permissions.

Former garage space has been adapted to create a practical workshop area complete with WC facilities, alongside a separate office/studio space, making it ideal for those working from home, hobbyists or anyone requiring additional storage and workspace.

Conveniently located close to local schools, shops, transport links and Peterborough City Centre, this is a property that offers both flexibility and future potential in equal measure.
